# GitHub Release Template — CFS Spool

This file is the **canonical template** used to write the body of every
GitHub Release for CFS Spool. The release automation (`build.yml`) extracts
the matching section from `CHANGELOG.md` and prepends the static blocks
below. **Do not improvise — copy the structure, replace the placeholders,
and keep the section order.**

If you are adding a release manually (e.g. via `gh release edit`),
reproduce this layout exactly.

---

## CFS Spool v{VERSION}

Native desktop application for reading and writing Creality CFS RFID tags.
Built with Wails v2 + React + shadcn/ui.

## Highlights

> One short paragraph (1–3 sentences) describing the most important change
> in this release, written for end users — not commit-style. Skip the
> section entirely if the release is purely internal (deps, CI, refactor).

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|----------|------|
| macOS Universal — Apple Silicon + Intel | `cfs-spool-darwin-universal.dmg` |
| Linux x86_64 | `cfs-spool-linux-amd64.zip` |
| Windows x86_64 | `cfs-spool-windows-amd64.zip` |

## Installation

### macOS

Open the DMG and drag CFS Spool to **Applications**. The app is signed and
notarized by Apple, so it opens without warnings.

### Linux / Windows

Extract the ZIP file and run the `cfs-spool` binary.

## Requirements

- **RFID Reader**: ACR122U or any compatible PC/SC reader.
- **Linux**: `sudo apt install pcscd libpcsclite1`
- **macOS / Windows**: PC/SC support is built in.
